prompt: Protection: you want to run a Grignard reaction on a substrate with both a ketone and a free OH. What should you do first?

options.label: Protect the OH as a silyl ether (TBS-Cl, imidazole), run Grignard, deprotect (TBAF).
Protect the C=O as an acetal, run Grignard on the alcohol.
Oxidize the OH to a ketone first.

explanation: Grignard reagents are strong bases AND nucleophiles — a free O–H will protonate them. Silyl protection masks the OH as an inert ether, then TBAF removes it after.
